title: The Determinant, explained
direction: A math notebook that moves. Warm paper, a fine graph grid, textbook serif math with italic variables, mono labels. One live coordinate plane is the spine of the film: the number inside the parallelogram is always the real determinant of the matrix on screen. Color is meaning: amber = positive area / the down diagonal, red = minus / flipped space.

devices.name: the live plane
devices.purpose: one grid transformed by the current matrix; the parallelogram's label is its live determinant (1 → 5 → −5 → 0). Never cuts, only moves between full frame, its panel and off-stage

devices.name: flying terms
devices.purpose: entries physically fly from the matrix into the formula / the 3×3 expansion, so the viewer sees where each number comes from

devices.name: diagonal highlighters
devices.purpose: amber band ↘ (ad), red band ↙ (bc): the formula's colors match

devices.name: rolling results
devices.purpose: a worked line rolls up into its simpler form (3 × 2 − 1 × 1 → 6 − 1 → 5)
